text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I love that song too! The 
"ta-tta-ra-tta~n♪" part feels so good, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Ace! Ah, so that's why you've been 
humming it so much lately. I kinda ended 
up memorizing it myself!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that's what it was! Singing before 
training really lifts my spirits and gets 
me pumped up.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I get that! I started playing music as 
part of my pre-training routine too!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you liked it that much? ...Alright, 
I've got an unused muffler towel from that 
band, so I'll give it to you, Tap!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! I'd rather you have it. 
And then we can hit a concert together 
someday and swing our towels around!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ace...! Thank you so much! So, when's the 
concert!? Tomorrow works just fine for me!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Aha ha ha! You're getting way ahead of 
yourself! Well then, how about we put some 
tunes on in my room and look into it 
together?!
